# Hitesh Modi — Engineer & Founder

> Software Engineer with 2+ years of production experience. Founder of Extrack (personal finance SaaS with paying customers). Expert in React Native, AWS, Python, AI/LLM integrations, and geospatial systems.

## About

Hitesh Modi is a Software Engineer and founder based in Guwahati, India. He builds architecture-first production systems and uses AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GPT-4) daily to ship faster without sacrificing code quality.

Key strengths:
- High-performance backend systems (AWS Lambda, Python, FastAPI)
- Mobile engineering (React Native / Expo — led Flutter→RN migration in 3 months)
- AI/LLM integration (OpenAI tool calling, agentic workflows, MCP servers)
- Geospatial systems (Mapbox GL, custom routing, offline packs)
- SaaS product ownership (Extrack — 4000+ commits, paying customers)

## Projects

### Extrack — Personal Finance SaaS
- URL: https://github.com/hiteshmodi0624/Extrack
- Description: Full-stack personal finance SaaS. Double-entry ledger, splits, lending, recurring transactions, budgets, AI suggestions, Razorpay autopay, MCP integration, Playwright E2E.
- Stack: Next.js 14, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito, Razorpay, OpenAI, Playwright
- Status: Live with paying customers. 4000+ commits.
